subject: 🎨 Claude Code /design ships visual mockups directly in your CLI
intro: Anthropic is having quite a week. They shipped /design in Claude Code, collapsing the gap between design and implementation. And separately, their research showed AI agents can catch and spread "mind viruses" to each other, mutating across networks. Two stories, one pattern: as agents get more capable, they also get more entangled. More power, more surface area for things to go sideways. The good news? A single system prompt warning nearly stops the spread cold. Simple fixes for wild problems.

news.headline: Anthropic ships Claude Code a UI design tool that builds editable artboards in your CLI
news.body: Claude Code just got a /design skill , and it changes how you build UIs from scratch. Here's the old way: you code a UI, hate how it looks, tweak it blindly, repeat forever. Not fun. Now you run /design inside Claude Code, and it generates multiple editable artboards, think of them like visual mockup options side by side. You pick the one you like, adjust it, then tell Claude to actually build it into real code. Design and code in one place, no switching tools. What this opens up: It's a research preview , so expect rough edges. Available on Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise. Just update Claude Code and run /design to try it.
bullets: Go from idea to working UI without touching Figma or any separate design tool
Pick from multiple layout options before committing to one
Edit the design visually, then let Claude handle the implementation
Works in both the CLI and the Desktop app

news.headline: Nous Research ships bot mode letting AI agents talk to each other in Hermes Desktop
news.body: Nous Research just shipped Bot Mode for Hermes Desktop, and it flips how you think about AI agents on your machine. Before this, you had one agent doing everything. Now you build a roster of named, specialized bots, each living in its own lane. Here is what each bot gets: Build a specialist bot once, and it is ready forever. No rebuilding context each session. It is open source, free , and runs entirely on your machine. To try it, download Hermes Desktop. Bot Mode is now bundled and on by default under Settings → Plugins .
bullets: Its own role, memory, skills, and chat history that persist forever
A pinned model, so your research bot runs a big model while your inbox bot runs a small, fast, local one
Scheduled tasks, like "summarize my inbox every morning," running automatically
Bot-to-bot messaging via a shared Agent Inbox, where bots hand off work using @mentions

news.headline: Claude Code CLI cuts CPU usage in half by fixing a garbage collector bug
news.body: Claude Code CLI just got a quiet but satisfying fix. It now uses 2x less CPU at p99 , which means your machine stops sounding like a jet engine during heavy coding sessions. Here's what was happening. Claude Code runs on a JavaScript runtime called Bun. Bun has a garbage collector, which is basically a cleanup crew that frees up memory. The problem? That crew was showing up on a fixed schedule, whether it was a good time or not. So right when Claude Code was working hardest, the cleanup crew would barge in and steal CPU resources. Classic bad timing. The fix is simple: the garbage collector now waits until the process is idle before cleaning up. No more interruptions at peak load. You get faster responses and a cooler laptop. Worth the update.
bullets: 2x CPU reduction at peak usage moments
Smoother performance during long, complex tasks
No config changes needed, just update Claude Code CLI
